svg.title: Cospectral Graphs and Eigendirections
svg.desc: Two nonisomorphic weighted graphs with spectrum 0,4,4,8. G1 is K4 with conductance 3 on edge 12 and 1 on every other edge; G2 is K2,2 with parts {1,2},{3,4} and all conductances 2. The eigenvalue-8 modes are z1=(1,-1,0,0)/sqrt(2) and z2=(1,1,-1,-1)/2. Blue denotes a positive component, orange a negative component, and gray zero. The E8 projectors differ, although their ranks and the Laplacian spectra agree.

cc:Work.dc:description: Two nonisomorphic weighted graphs with spectrum 0,4,4,8. G1 is K4 with conductance 3 on edge 12 and 1 on every other edge; G2 is K2,2 with parts {1,2},{3,4} and all conductances 2. The eigenvalue-8 modes are z1=(1,-1,0,0)/sqrt(2) and z2=(1,1,-1,-1)/2. Blue denotes a positive component, orange a negative component, and gray zero. The E8 projectors differ, although their ranks and the Laplacian spectra agree.
